scope: Fictional SQLite durable inbox only; no real send, model, product Store or WeChat adapter

contract.identity: epoch and sequence, assigned by trusted fixture controller; not authenticated live origin
contract.deduplication: inbox row, sequence cursor and operation marker commit in one database transaction
contract.stop: BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes with accept; successful ACK only after COMMIT
contract.late_ack: older committed accept ACK may arrive after STOP ACK; no later inbox insert permitted
contract.closed_epoch: cannot be reopened; old STOP must not affect a new active epoch
contract.busy: explicit failure, not a successful stop ACK
contract.durability: WAL and synchronous FULL; actual process crashes tested, not power loss

limitations: No claim of exactly-once external network effects or actual message sending.
Already committed rows are retained and may be read later; no product consumer is connected.
No target code patch, trampoline execution, arbitrary pointer validation or ABI authentication.
No disk/power/network-filesystem failure or arbitrary corruption tests.
